rule: A lane may draft autonomously only when its exact template and one accepted full positive exemplar are bound. Rejected examples remain calibration-only.

lanes.publishesIn: Top of the current Daily only when qualified
lanes.readerJob: Interrupt only when waiting for the next Daily would materially disadvantage the reader.
sourceRules: current primary or official evidence
independent verification proportionate to risk
timestamped claim map
mandatory human hold for safety, privacy, health, legal, political or incident claims
lanes.distinctFrom: A later update or interesting announcement belongs in The Daily unless delay changes the reader's choice.

lanes.readerJob: Explain what changed, what it actually means and what the reader should know or do today.

templateBeats: what evidence establishes and does not
work and non-work relevance when material
sourceRules: exact current source and claim map
AIDB comparison where relevant
primary evidence before summaries
dated freshness and correction owner
lanes.distinctFrom: The Daily reports one dated change; Weekly synthesizes several, Big Picture goes deeper and STRAiGHT TALK maintains a recurring answer.

lanes.readerJob: Show what accumulated, conflicted or changed direction across the week.
templateBeats: tip of the week only if subordinate and earned
sourceRules: at least two distinct developments
primary or official evidence for each
independent context proportionate to risk
no concatenated Daily summaries
lanes.distinctFrom: A Weekly is synthesis, not seven headlines and not one long Daily story.

lanes.publishesIn: The Big Picture feature and searchable archive
lanes.readerJob: Answer the larger consequential question behind several headlines and explain what the pattern really means.
sourceRules: multiple primary sources or one primary source plus material independent scrutiny
separate confirmed evidence, inference and position
link dated precursor stories
link maintained evergreen concept where applicable
lanes.distinctFrom: Big Picture explains a pattern deeply; it is not the old Tribune opinion column, a Weekly recap or a timeless textbook chapter.

lanes.publishesIn: NewsStand question column consuming the one canonical STRAiGHT TALK / Straight Answers record
lanes.readerJob: Give a durable plain-language answer to a recurring AI question.
templateBeats: work and non-work example when material
linked dated update if the answer changes
sourceRules: consume the canonical LIBRAiRY answer ID
current primary evidence for volatile claims
never create a competing NewsStand answer canon
lanes.distinctFrom: STRAiGHT TALK answers a recurring question; The Daily reports today's change and Dear Miss Jeeves fixes one practical recurring problem.

lanes.publishesIn: The Weekly advice desk; banked items may be released one at a time and later adapted for radio
lanes.readerJob: Start with a familiar AI frustration, explain why it keeps happening and give a realistic next move.
templateBeats: what may be a product or workflow limit
when to stop prompting and change the workflow
sourceRules: current product documentation for product-specific claims
maintained LAiDIES concept for durable mechanism
no invented user submission until intake exists
lanes.distinctFrom: Dear Miss Jeeves diagnoses a recurring practical problem; Paige gives one compact move and STRAiGHT TALK answers a durable general question.

lanes.readerJob: Give one useful work-facing AI action the reader can try today.
sourceRules: verified current source or admitted LAiDIES concept
exact freshness and correction binding
no context-free hack or universal promise
lanes.distinctFrom: Paige is practical and work-facing; Promptoscope is playful and normally non-work; Career/Work-Life begins with genuine career or life guidance.

lanes.publishesIn: Daily or Weekly service desk according to depth
lanes.readerJob: Offer useful career or life guidance that stands on its own, then use a faithful AI parallel to illuminate both.
sourceRules: credible original non-AI advice source or accountable LAiDIES author
headline and complete prefix before the explicit AI connection must remain non-AI career or life guidance
AI connection must map a real mechanism
no therapy, legal advice or claim that AI solves a structural problem
lanes.distinctFrom: It must remain recognizable and useful career or life guidance when the complete AI connection is removed; AI disclosure, prompting and AI workflow advice belong elsewhere even when metadata calls them career guidance.

lanes.readerJob: Use a funny horoscope frame to make one recognizable, normally non-work AI-use pattern memorable.
sourceRules: verified source or admitted LAiDIES concept
exact freshness and correction binding
no prediction, mystical guidance, ad or disguised Paige tip
lanes.distinctFrom: Promptoscope is funny and normally non-work; Paige is a crisp work-facing action and Mme CLAi-O is a fixed non-predictive reading from her governed deck.

lanes.readerJob: Explain one term in plain language, show where it fits in the larger AI system and connect it to the week's reporting.
templateBeats: place in the larger AI system
sourceRules: current maintained concept source
exact Weekly story binding
primary evidence for volatile examples
one durable concept owner and freshness trigger
lanes.distinctFrom: Term of the Week explains durable meaning through current news; it is not a detached glossary card, a Daily story or a second concept canon.

lanes.publicName: Mme CLAi-O's Reading of the Day
lanes.readerJob: Offer one playful fixed reading and bounded reflective move without pretending to predict or personalize the reader's future.
sourceRules: exact governed deck ID and immutable card text
dated deterministic selection
product owner, Brand and Safety acceptance
never generated from reader data
lanes.distinctFrom: Mme CLAi-O uses her governed card deck; Promptoscope is a comic AI-use horoscope and cannot borrow this authority.

lanes.readerJob: Give the Daily an era-aware listening pick with one useful reason it belongs today.
templateBeats: one-sentence connection to today's paper or mood
sourceRules: exact track and artist metadata
current lawful listening route
no reproduced lyrics beyond permitted quotation
lanes.distinctFrom: This is an editorial listening pick, not a KSVL teaching-song commission.

lanes.readerJob: Reveal one genuinely useful or delightful fact about LAiDIES and route the reader to use it.
templateBeats: why it is useful or surprising
one exact site action or destination
sourceRules: current live-route or canonical feature evidence
no unlaunched destination or inflated availability claim
lanes.distinctFrom: It teaches readers how to get more from LAiDIES; it is not general AI trivia.

lanes.readerJob: Tell residents what changed in SUNNYVAiLE and where to go next.
sourceRules: current release and public verification
no coming-soon promise without authority
lanes.distinctFrom: Town Notes reports real site changes; fictional town material must be separately labelled.

lanes.readerJob: Invite one small useful act of noticing, learning or mutual support.
templateBeats: privacy and safety boundary where needed
sourceRules: admitted concept or accountable town action
no fabricated community participation
lanes.distinctFrom: This is an action, not an inspirational quote or engagement prompt.

lanes.publishesIn: Daily service desk clearly separated from sourced reporting
lanes.readerJob: Make the town feel alive through clearly fictional, canon-consistent fun.
templateBeats: one town incident, notice or joke
sourceRules: current canon index
character owner approval for direct quotations
no invented launch or user activity
lanes.distinctFrom: Fiction is visibly separate from evidence-desk reporting and cannot simulate real community activity.
